title: Regulatory obligations and submission bundle
description: Authoritative change review, owned obligations, regulatory submission, and legal ontology sliver.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: WorkflowBundle
metadata:
  name: legal-regulatory-obligations
  title: Regulatory obligations and submission bundle
  description: Authoritative change review, owned obligations, regulatory submission, and a legal ontology sliver.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  workflowRef: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03
  ontology:
    ref: ladder://ontologies/builtin/legal
    mode: sliver
    selection:
      propertyRefs:
        - regulatory_submission.submission_type
        - regulatory_submission.regulator
        - regulatory_submission.subject_of_submission
        - regulatory_submission.submission_status
        - legal_party.submitting_entity_name
      relationshipIds: [submitted_by]
  forms:
    - { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, role: completion }
  documents:
    - { ref: ladder://documents/docubricks/legal/court_filing, role: supporting }
  bindings:
    - id: regulator-to-authority
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/1 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03, path: /spec/nodes/0/inputSchema/properties/instructions }
      ontologyPropertyRef: regulatory_submission.regulator
      direction: input
    - id: submission-type-to-extraction
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03, path: /spec/nodes/1/prompt }
      ontologyPropertyRef: regulatory_submission.submission_type
      direction: input
    - id: subject-to-register
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/1/fields/5 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03, path: /spec/nodes/2/name }
      ontologyPropertyRef: regulatory_submission.subject_of_submission
      direction: output
    - id: entity-to-approval
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/2/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03, path: /spec/nodes/4/name }
      ontologyPropertyRef: legal_party.submitting_entity_name
      direction: approval
    - id: status-to-result
      source: { ref: ladder://forms/docubricks/legal/regulatory_submission, path: /spec/pages/0/sections/4/fields/0 }
      target: { ref: ladder://workflows/builtin/wf-legal-03, path: /spec/nodes/5/name }
      ontologyPropertyRef: regulatory_submission.submission_status
      direction: output
